faqGeneral.title: How long does implementation take?
faqGeneral.answer: Answer: Most teams are up and running within 24–48 hours. Our visual builder and pre-built templates enable fast deployment without needing a developer.

faqGeneral.title: Is my data used to train public AI models?
faqGeneral.answer: Answer: Absolutely not. We follow strict data sovereignty practices. Your data is encrypted, isolated, and never used to train public models.

faqGeneral.title: Can bigA.i integrate with legacy software?
faqGeneral.answer: Answer: Yes. Beyond our 500+ native integrations, we provide a robust API and Webhook system to connect with any proprietary or legacy system in your stack.

faqGeneral.title: Do you offer discounts for non-profits?
faqGeneral.answer: Answer: Yes. We support non-profit and mission-driven organizations with special pricing options. If you qualify, simply reach out to our team and we’ll be happy to discuss available discounts and plans.

faqPricing.title: Is there a free trial available?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: Yes. You can start with our free plan (or a 14-day trial) to explore the core features before committing to a paid plan.

faqPricing.title: Can I change my plan later?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time based on your needs, with no restrictions or long-term commitments.

faqPricing.title: Are there any hidden fees?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: No. All pricing and feature limits are clearly listed on this page. You’ll only pay for the plan you choose.

faqPricing.title: Do you offer monthly and yearly billing?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: Yes. You can choose monthly billing or save with annual billing at a discounted rate, depending on what works best for your team.

faqPricing.title: What payment methods do you accept?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: We accept major credit cards and secure online payment methods. For Enterprise plans, custom invoicing is available.

faqPricing.title: Do you offer refunds?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: We offer a refund policy within the first X days of purchase. Please contact our support team for assistance.

faqPricing.title: Which plan is right for me?
faqPricing.answer:
Answer: 

Starter – Best for individuals or small projects.

Pro – Ideal for growing teams and advanced workflows.

Enterprise – Built for organizations needing scale, security, and dedicated support.

faqPricing.title: What’s the difference between plans?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: Higher-tier plans include more usage limits, advanced features, priority support, and additional integrations.

faqPricing.title: What happens if I exceed my usage limit?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: You’ll be notified in advance. You can either upgrade your plan or purchase additional usage if available.

faqPricing.title: What kind of support do you provide?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: All paid plans include email support. Pro and Enterprise plans include priority support, and Enterprise customers receive a dedicated account manager.

faqPricing.title: How long does it take to get started?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: You can get started immediately after signing up. Enterprise onboarding is handled by our team to ensure a smooth setup.

faqPricing.title: Do you offer custom pricing?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: Yes. Our Enterprise plan includes custom pricing tailored to your usage, security requirements, and team size. Contact our sales team for details.

faqPricing.title: Do you offer special discounts?
faqPricing.answer: Answer: We offer special pricing for eligible organizations. Please reach out to our team to learn more about available discounts and eligibility.
